instruction: Look at gui_011_nozzle_blank.step in SolidWorks, a cylindrical nozzle blank of outside diameter 36 mm spanning Z=0 to Z=70, with an existing 10 mm through center bore on the Z axis. Machine the upper half from Z=35 to Z=70 into an approximately 15 degree external taper, ending at top outside diameter 18 mm and smoothly meeting the original 36 mm diameter at Z=35. Add a bottom flange from Z=-8 to Z=0 with outside diameter 60 mm and thickness 8 mm. Add four through bolt holes of diameter 6 mm on flange hole radius 23 mm. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_011_nozzle_flanged_out.step with the nozzle axis on Z. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.

command: import pyautogui, time; time.sleep(20); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(5)
